title: Coast Guard rescues 2 aboard 37-foot disabled boat near Gasparilla Pass
credit: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Clearwater
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater helicopter crew rescued two men after their 37-foot sailing vessel became disabled and started taking on water near Gasparilla Pass, Florida, on Sept. 27, 2024. The two men were hoisted off the abandoned railroad tracks and safely transferred to the mainland with no reported injuries. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Clearwater)
